data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/widgets.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-role schema for manifests/<saas>/widgets.yaml body (post-_meta-strip). Accepts EITHER inline widgets (a non-empty widgets map) OR an extends-stub (extends: <widget-library>). Permissive on per-widget invoke recipe shape — runtime validator handles vocabulary checks.
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled for v0
changelog: 1.1.0 (2026-05-18): drop minProperties:1 + required:widgets to accommodate the extends-stub pattern from the 2026-05-16 four-cleanup refactor (per-app widgets.yaml is a 2-line extends: stub with no inline widgets). Adds anyOf gate so authors still get a real-shape error when both extends and widgets are missing/empty.

title: Spec 60 — widgets.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-SaaS widgets.yaml file after the _meta block is stripped. Accepts either an inline widgets map (>=1 widget) OR an extends-stub (extends: <widget-library>). extends and defaults_by_type are optional. The widgets map is optional but if present must be an object.

extends.description: Optional path to a widget-library file that this manifest inherits from (e.g. widget-libraries/gmail.widgets.yaml).

widgets.description: Map of widget id (e.g. gmail.compose_button) → widget definition (archetype + invoke recipe). May be empty when extends is present.

defaults_by_type.description: Map of schema field type (text, email, list<email>, …) → default widget id. Used by fill_fields when a field has no explicit widget.
